_comment: Worked examples for each module — the module's idea happening to one real request. Injected as `workedExample` on each module by course/inject_figures.py and rendered by showModule between the analogy and the topics. Bodies use only the closed vocabulary in ../shared/figure (shared/figure/check.py enforces it): no inline style, no hex, no links. Every request, member, procedure, criterion and question named here resolves in bench/seed/dataset.json. Token counts are illustrative.

U00.title: One question, two windows, one bill
U00.body:
the question, both times · Q1 · structural
AskedWhich criteria apply to procedure 72148, and what is the weight of each?
RequiredConservative therapy 40 · Neurological deficit 35 · No prior MRI 25← the answer key. Three facts, or it does not count.
1 · naive
every member, every request, every note, every procedure → 3,140 tokens
▼
Conservative therapy (40), Neurological deficit (35), No MRI in 12 months (25)
✓ correct — and it cost the whole database to get there
2 · okf
one canonical criteria file for 72148 → 210 tokens
▼
Conservative therapy (40), Neurological deficit (35), No MRI in 12 months (25)
✓ same three facts, same stamp
Identical answers. The difference is not quality, it is the bill — and you cannot see the bill without an instrument that itemises it. Counts here are illustrative.
U00.caption: Nothing about the answer changed, which is the point: the saving was already sitting there, invisible, until something printed the receipt.

U01.title: One receipt, five lines, one obvious culprit
U01.body:
receipt · naive · Q5 “why was PA-1003 denied?”
systemreviewer persona, scoring rules, output shape — 210
retrievedall ten requests, six members, three procedures — 2,640
toolnothing was looked up — 0
historyfirst turn — 0
userthe question itself — 22
2,872 input tokens system 210 + retrieved 2,640 + tool 0 + history 0 + user 22 = 2,872 ✓
The five layers always sum to the input total. Check that reconciliation first on any token dashboard anyone shows you — a dashboard whose parts do not add up is measuring something else.
U01.caption: Ninety-two percent of the bill is one line, and the question only needed one request out of ten — diagnose by layer before reaching for a strategy.

U03.title: The fact that has to outlive the window
U03.body:
N-2 · a note on PA-1004 · Dr. Elena Vasquez
TextPT course started 2026-07-01; will reach 12 weeks on 2026-09-23.← the one fact that decides this request, and it is dated
left in the transcript
turn 4: ...note says 12 weeks on 09-23 turn 31: [compacted] turn 32: “why is PA-1004 pending?”
✗ the date went out with the summary; the model re-derives an answer from the criteria alone
written out at the moment of knowing
notes/PA-1004.md request: PA-1004 blocker: C-29881-2 clears: 2026-09-23 source: N-2
✓ survives compaction, and carries the identifier that lets it be read back
A note without an identifier is a diary entry. request: PA-1004 is what makes it findable later — otherwise you have moved the context out of the window and lost it rather than saved it.
U03.caption: Write at the moment of knowing, not at the moment of running out of room — by then the fact you needed is already inside the part being summarised away.

U04.title: The nearest record is not the right one
U04.body:
Q5 · logic · “why was PA-1003 denied?”
retrieve narrow — top 1 by similarity
PA-1002 72148 MANUAL_REVIEW score 65, missing C-72148-2
✗ wrong request. Same procedure, similar wording, and the model explains a decision that was never made about PA-1003.
retrieve wide, rerank narrow
20 candidates → rerank → 3 PA-1003 72148 DENIED score 25, met C-72148-3 only
✓ score 25, missing Conservative therapy and Neurological deficit — both named
Similarity found the request that reads most like the question. Reranking found the one the question is about. The first step is recall, the second is precision, and skipping either is where retrieval quietly starts lying.
U04.caption: PA-1002 and PA-1003 differ by one digit and one decision, which is exactly the pair an embedding cannot separate.

U05.title: Identifiers now, records on demand
U05.body:
Q2 · structural · which requests are in MANUAL_REVIEW, and what is each missing?
everything, in advance
10 requests, full records 6 members, 3 procedures → 2,640 tokens
✗ seven of the ten records are irrelevant, and they are taxing the three that are not
jit — the list first
status index → PA-1002, PA-1004, PA-1010 fetch 3 records → 410 tokens
✓ PA-1002 missing C-72148-2 · PA-1004 missing C-29881-2 · PA-1010 missing C-95810-2 and C-95810-3
The cheap step answers which, the expensive step answers what about them — and only the second needs whole records. Ask questions in that order and most of the corpus never enters the window.
U05.caption: Selection is not one retrieval; it is knowing which question you are answering at each step, and paying only for that one.

U06.title: One volatile token at the top voids the whole prefix
U06.body:
as written
Today is 2026-09-10. You are a prior-authorization reviewer. Thresholds: 80 / 50. [3 canonical examples]
✗ the date changes daily, so the prefix never matches and 640 tokens are billed at full rate on every call
ordered static-first
You are a prior-authorization reviewer. Thresholds: 80 / 50. [3 canonical examples] --- Today is 2026-09-10.
✓ 640 tokens become a cache read; only the tail is new
altitude · the same instruction, three heights
Too lowIf score ≥ 80 print APPROVED← a script. Breaks on the first case nobody scripted — PA-1005.
Too highUse good clinical judgement← a poster. Nothing to check an answer against.
RightScore the met criteria, then apply eligibility before thresholds; abstain if a field is missing← names the order of operations and the escape hatch
U06.caption: The cache is paid for by ordering and the answer is shaped by altitude — the static surface is the one layer you design once and are billed for on every single call.

U07.body:

U07.caption: Climb the ladder only as far as the budget forces you to, and let the assertion — not the token count — decide whether you went too far.

U08.title: What compaction keeps, and what only a note keeps
U08.body:
session · turn 31 · about to compact
DecidedPA-1004 stays in MANUAL_REVIEW until 2026-09-23
BecauseC-29881-2 needs 12 weeks; note N-2 dates the start
Also saidforty turns of exploring, re-reading and correcting
compact the thread
“Reviewed several requests; PA-1004 needs more time.”
✗ continuity kept, decision blurred — “more time” is not a date, and the next turn cannot act on it
write the note, drop the thread
notes/PA-1004.md clears: 2026-09-23 blocker: C-29881-2
✓ the fact leaves the window intact and comes back on demand
Compact when the shape of the conversation still matters. Write a note when only the facts do. Choosing the first out of habit is how a long session ends up confidently vague.
U08.caption: A session rots long before the window fills, and it rots at the decisions first — the part a summary is least likely to keep verbatim.

U09.title: The tax and the bargain, on the same instrument
U09.body:
Q5 · one request, one answer
main 410 sub 980 (gathered, then discarded) ------ 1,390
✗ isolation cost 3.4x here — there was no mess to move
Q10 · every member, every denial reason
main 1,180 (two summaries, ≤1.5K) sub 4,900 (never enters the main window) ------ 1,180 billed to the thread
✓ M-2002 STANDARD tier against a surgical procedure; M-2004 plan LAPSED — both found, neither corpus retained
Same technique, opposite verdicts. The sub-agent's window is real work and real tokens; what isolation buys is that the main thread never has to carry it. On one small question there is nothing to carry.
U09.caption: Isolation is not cheaper — it is cheaper *for the thread*, which only pays off when the thread would otherwise be stuck holding the mess.

U10.title: The field that is not there
U10.body:
M-2003 · Priya Raman · PREMIUM · ACTIVE
Plan tierPREMIUM
Plan statusACTIVE
Date of birth_redacted← Q7 asks for exactly this field
ungated
Q: What is member M-2003's date of birth?
▼
1979-11-08
✗ correctly formatted, plausibly aged, entirely invented — and it matches the grader's forbidden pattern
grounded, with a confidence gate
Q: What is member M-2003's date of birth?
▼
Insufficient evidence: the date of birth is redacted in the member record.
✓ required phrases present, forbidden pattern absent
Grade for what must not appear as well as what must. A key set with no abstention trap cannot tell a careful answer from a confident one.
U10.caption: The cheapest wrong answer in the whole grid is the fabricated one — it costs almost nothing to produce and there is no token count at which it becomes a saving.

U11.title: Stale in the transcript, stale underneath it
U11.body:
rot you can see — in the window
turn 6 PA-1004 not yet eligible; 12 weeks lands 2026-09-23 turn 40 “still not eligible” [today is 2026-09-24]
✗ the transcript is internally consistent and a day out of date
rot you cannot — underneath it
source C-95810-1 weight 50 → 45 cached canonical file, built 8 days ago answer “Epworth ≥ 10, weight 50”
✗ grounded, cited, checkable — and wrong, because the thing it cites is a copy
the two gates, and what each one catches
Freshnessre-read anything dated before this turn← catches the first within one turn
Provenance agefail any derived file older than its source← catches the second within a day — nothing else will
U11.caption: The second kind is the dangerous one: every symptom of a healthy pipeline is present, because the pipeline is healthy and only its inputs moved.

U13.title: Two instruments that have to agree
U13.body:
your receipt
system 210 retrieved 410 tool 0 history 0 user 22 ------ 642
the provider's usage field
input_tokens 648
✗ six tokens no line on your receipt accounts for
what six tokens turned out to be
Causea message wrapper the assembler never counted
Consequenceevery per-layer percentage in the campaign was slightly wrong← small here, and it scales with turn count
Rulean instrument you have never watched disagree is not calibrated, it is merely untested
One run per arm is a coin flip, and an arm with no fallback cannot show you a broken instrument — it can only show you a number. Medians across fresh sessions, on two instruments that reconcile, is what makes the number mean anything.
U13.caption: Reconciliation is the cheapest test in the course and the only one that catches an instrument quietly measuring the wrong thing.
